goal: Client-proposal render: furnish the empty glazed skybridge corridor as an aperitivo lounge event space.
facts: Add curved deep-blue velvet lounge sofas, round velvet poufs with brushed-gold bases, tall standing bar tables, and one neutral white aperitivo bar counter.
locks: Preserve the corridor architecture exactly: X-shaped steel braces, glazing, skylight roof beams, ceiling, light fixtures, parquet floor, viewpoint, perspective, and sunlight with its shadow pattern.
No logos, brand names, text, or people anywhere in the image.
Bar counter is plain white with a brushed-steel top and no graphics.
freedoms: Exact number and arrangement of furniture pieces, as long as a clear walkway remains along the corridor.
Small tabletop items such as glasses, bottles without labels, and snack bowls.
composition: Group sofas and poufs around low round tables near the windows; place tall standing tables in a row along the corridor; place the bar counter in the mid-ground, parallel to the inner wall, leaving a walkway.
rendering: Photorealistic interior photograph; furniture casts shadows consistent with the existing sunlight and window pattern; correct scale and floor contact.
